label: 2 — Interactive Code Generation (iter 1, cold)
summary: Full cold codegen for the lre case study from requirement_all.json: 15 Java files (annotation, mode, constants, events, datamodel, sensor, actuator, 5 operations, controller) plus result_codegen.json. All 52 requirements traced. 8 review items below.

issues.title: cstc/cdyn are plain int, not @RoboChartType("nat")
issues.detail: LRE-Var5/Var6 call cstc/cdyn 'natural number' variables but define -1 as the no-obstacle sentinel. A nat cannot hold -1 (would break Dafny nat semantics), so both fields and the sensor index parameters stay int with no annotation.

issues.title: Beh4 literal threshold 1 mapped to minSafeDist
issues.detail: LRE-Beh4 says odist(cdyn) > 1 and odist(cstc) > 1; minSafeDist defaults to 1 and is described as the minimal safe distance to any obstacle, so the guards use LreConstants.minSafeDist instead of a bare literal. vel <= 1 keeps the literal (1 m/s is the MOM nominal speed, no named constant).

issues.title: CheckOPEZ/CalcCPA read the closest-obstacle index from the Sensor directly
issues.detail: LRE-OP2/OP5 say these operations use the index computed by CalcCStc/CalcCDyn. The compute() rules restrict RHS expressions to sensor calls and own fields, so CheckOPEZ and CalcCPA call sensor.closestStaticIndex()/closestDynamicIndex() themselves — the identical value, without a cross-operation getter call.

issues.title: CalcCPA formula: horizontal-plane CPA with hdist-based separation
issues.detail: LRE-OP5 names no formula. Implemented standard horizontal CPA: relative velocity v = obstacle velocity - AUV velocity; tcpa = -(r.v)/(v.v); cda^2 = hdist(cdyn)^2 - (r.v)^2/(v.v). Using hdist for the separation term means the Sensor's safe-large default makes cda large when no dynamic obstacle exists (the zero-default accessors alone would give a spurious cda=0). When v.v = 0 the separation never changes: tcpa = -1 (never approaching), cda = current hdist. cda^2 clamped at 0 before sqrt.

issues.title: Sensor safe large distance = 1.0e6 m
issues.detail: LRE-DM5 requires 'a safe large distance' for missing obstacles but gives no value. 1.0e6 is far above every threshold (all default 1).

issues.title: CAM has no specified entry action or evasive output
issues.detail: LRE-FR4 says CAM 'performs evasive manoeuvres' but no requirement defines an advVel/advHdng value for it, and LRE-DM7 limits outputs to advVel/advHdng. CAM is entered with no output; the evasive manoeuvre itself is unspecified and unimplemented.

issues.title: Transition priority order within MOM/HCM invented
issues.detail: Requirements do not rank simultaneous transitions. Chosen inner order: operator events first (reqOCM, endTask, reqHCM), then autonomous inOpez -> OCM, then CAM guard (cda/tcpa), then the three HCM guards. HCM: reqOCM, inOpez, CAM guard, then return-to-MOM.

issues.title: Mode entry advisories fired inline at every entering transition
issues.detail: MOM entry advVel(1) duplicated on OCM->MOM and HCM->MOM (LRE-FR2); HCM entry advVel(0) duplicated on all four MOM->HCM transitions including reqHCM (LRE-FR3 says 0 m/s on entering HCM). advVel(0) also fired on MOM->OCM endTask (LRE-Beh7) and CAM->OCM safe (LRE-Beh18) as transition actions.

issues.title: No demo main class or unit tests generated
issues.detail: Requirements define no executable scenario; only the library code needed by the verification pipeline was generated.

next_step: Run the deterministic pipeline (compile through vacuity) and iterate on its feedback.
